notes: Spotify 'skipped' column ignored; forward-button endings (reason_end = fwdbtn) used instead.
Card transactions were ~7x duplicated with random blanks; rows were merged by trans_id and blanks filled from copies.
Card coordinates are mostly outside India, so they are not used for mapping.
Card city and state often disagree (e.g. Durgapur, Rajasthan): treat them as independent labels, not one address.
Card amounts are assumed to be INR, like the household data. About 15% of reconstructed card rows had no time or amount and were dropped.
Card numbers and customer ids are lossy (scientific notation) and are dropped.
The three datasets do not identify one person. Combining them is a deliberate fictional framing.
